Context: 3. Regular Promotions

| 33. | Level 16 | Level 17 | 1 Year |  
- (c) Reservations.Reservations at 15% for SCs, 7 1h % for STs for all posts and 1% each for blind, deaf-mute, and orthopaedically handicapped in Groups 'C' and MTS posts only are admissible in cases of promotions in grades/ services / posts in which the element of direct recruitment, if any, does not exceed 75%. There are no reservations in promotions for any other categories, OBCs, Ex-Servicemen, etc.
